343def read_py_vars(path):344    """Read project/named/version/description text variables from a .py file (no import, no AST)."""345    result = {'project': '', 'named': '', 'version': '', 'description': ''}346    try:347        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')348    except OSError:349        return result350    for match in FOLDER_VAR_RE.finditer(text):351        key = match.group(1)352        if result[key]:353            continue354        result[key] = next((g for g in match.group(2, 3, 4) if g is not None), '').strip()355    return result

2519    def _draw_text_block(self, draw, lines, font, center_x, top_y, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255), spacing=8):2520        if not lines:2521            return top_y2522        boxes = [draw.textbbox((0, 0), line, font=font) for line in lines]2523        widths = [box[2] - box[0] for box in boxes]2524        heights = [box[3] - box[1] for box in boxes]2525        total_height = sum(heights) + spacing * max(0, len(lines) - 1)2526        current_y = top_y2527        for line, box, width, height in zip(lines, boxes, widths, heights):2528            x = center_x - (width / 2) - box[0]2529            y = current_y - box[1]2530            draw.text((x + 2, y + 2), line, font=font, fill=(0, 0, 0, 180))2531            draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)2532            current_y += height + spacing2533        return top_y + total_height

2722    def _pillow_glyph_icon(self, app, destination):2723        if Image is None or ImageDraw is None or ImageFont is None:2724            return None2725        name = self._gateway_app_name(app)2726        glyph = ''.join(char for char in name if char.isalnum())[:2].upper() or '?'2727        image = Image.new('RGBA', (256, 256), (50, 99, 142, 255))2728        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)2729        try:2730            font = ImageFont.truetype('arial.ttf', 112)2731        except Exception:2732            font = ImageFont.load_default()2733        bounds = draw.textbbox((0, 0), glyph, font=font)2734        width = bounds[2] - bounds[0]2735        height = bounds[3] - bounds[1]2736        draw.text(2737            ((256 - width) / 2 - bounds[0], (256 - height) / 2 - bounds[1]),2738            glyph, fill=(255, 255, 255, 255), font=font2739        )2740        image.save(2741            destination, format='ICO',2742            sizes=[(16, 16), (24, 24), (32, 32), (48, 48),2743                   (64, 64), (128, 128), (256, 256)]2744        )2745        return destination

1885    def _resolve_gateway_icon(self, app):1886        raw_icon = str(app.get('icon') or '').strip()1887        app_path = self._gateway_application_path(app)1888        app_dir = app_path.parent if app_path else self.gateway_json_path().parent1889        candidates = []18901891        if raw_icon:1892            icon_path = Path(os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(raw_icon)))1893            if icon_path.is_absolute():1894                candidates.append(icon_path)1895            else:1896                candidates.extend((1897                    app_dir / icon_path,1898                    self.gateway_json_path().parent / icon_path,1899                    self.icon_dir / icon_path,1900                ))1901        if app_path:1902            candidates.extend((1903                app_path.with_suffix('.ico'),1904                app_dir / 'app.ico',1905                app_dir / 'icon.ico',1906            ))19071908        seen = set()1909        for candidate in candidates:1910            key = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(str(candidate)))1911            if key in seen:1912                continue1913            seen.add(key)1914            try:1915                if candidate.is_file():1916                    return candidate1917            except OSError:1918                pass1919        return None

568    def _show_startup_splash(self):569        """Show this application's splash while the main interface is initialising."""570        if Image is None or ImageTk is None:571            return572        splash_path = self._startup_splash_path()573        if splash_path is None:574            return575        try:576            with Image.open(splash_path) as opened:577                image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(opened).convert('RGBA')578            splash = tk.Toplevel(self.window)579            splash.withdraw()580            splash.overrideredirect(True)581            try:582                splash.attributes('-topmost', True)583            except tk.TclError:584                pass585            self.startup_splash_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image)586            ttk.Label(splash, image=self.startup_splash_photo).pack()587            splash.update_idletasks()588            width = image.width589            height = image.height590            screen_width = splash.winfo_screenwidth()591            screen_height = splash.winfo_screenheight()592            x = max(0, (screen_width - width) // 2)593            y = max(0, (screen_height - height) // 2)594            splash.geometry(f'{width}x{height}+{x}+{y}')595            splash.deiconify()596            splash.lift()597            splash.update()598            self.startup_splash_window = splash599        except Exception:600            self.startup_splash_window = None601            self.startup_splash_photo = None

Relative luminance is sufficient3062                    # here to choose readable diagram colours.3063                    luminance = (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b) / 655353064                    return luminance < 0.483065                except Exception:3066                    pass3067        name = str(theme_name or '').lower()3068        return name.startswith('dark') or 'graphite' in name or 'contrast black' in name or 'contrast navy' in name

1469    def folder_image_dropped(self, event):1470        paths = self._gateway_drop_paths(event)1471        if len(paths) != 1:1472            self.folder_drop_refused('Drop exactly one PNG or JPG file.')1473            return 'refuse_drop'1474        if self.folder_drop_busy:1475            self.folder_drop_refused('Drop refused: the previous image is still being processed.')1476            return 'refuse_drop'1477        if self.selected_folder_py() is None:1478            self.folder_drop_refused('Select a .py file before dropping an image.')1479            return 'refuse_drop'1480        source = paths[0]1481        if source.suffix.casefold() not in {'.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg'} or not source.is_file():1482            self.folder_drop_refused('Drop one existing PNG, JPG or JPEG file.')1483            return 'refuse_drop'1484        # Release the native drop capture first; image work runs on the next idle cycle.1485        self.folder_drop_busy = True1486        if self.folder_dnd_frame is not None:1487            self.folder_dnd_frame.set_feedback('Named File', f'Queued: {source.name}')1488        try:1489            self.after_idle(self._process_folder_drop, source)1490        except Exception as exc:1491            self.folder_drop_busy = False1492            self.folder_drop_refused(f'Drop could not be queued: {exc}')1493            return 'refuse_drop'1494        return 'copy'

2999    def scan_records(self):3000        icon_dir = self.icon_dir3001        groups = {}3002        if not icon_dir.exists():3003            return []3004        for p in icon_dir.iterdir():3005            if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in {'.ico', '.png'}:3006                continue3007            stem = p.stem3008            base = stem3009            size = ''3010            if p.suffix.lower() == '.png' and '_' in stem:3011                maybe_base, maybe_size = stem.rsplit('_', 1)3012                if maybe_size.isdigit():3013                    base, size = maybe_base, maybe_size3014            rec = groups.setdefault(base.lower(), {'name': base, 'ico': '', 'pngs': [], 'files': [], 'updated': 0})3015            rec['files'].append(str(p))3016            rec['updated'] = max(rec['updated'], p.stat().st_mtime)3017            if p.suffix.lower() == '.ico':3018                rec['ico'] = str(p)3019            elif size:3020                rec['pngs'].append(int(size))3021            else:3022                rec['pngs'].append('base')3023        out = list(groups.values())3024        for rec in out:3025            rec['pngs'] = sorted(rec['pngs'], key=lambda v: (isinstance(v, str), str(v)))3026            rec['path'] = rec['ico'] or (rec['files'][0] if rec['files'] else '')3027        return sorted(out, key=lambda r: r['name'].lower())
